descriptionChirho: Abstract moral quality of being right, just, or upright; the standard ethical attribute of God or of human conduct, encompassing all pronominal, prepositional, and conjunctive inflections of the base noun tsedheq.

Adjectival predication where tsedheq functions as a predicate adjective meaning 'just' or 'righteous,' consistently rendered across languages with adjective forms (Spanish 'justa,' Hindi 'सीधा,' Arabic 'عَادِلٌ,' Korean '공정한/의로운') rather than as the abstract noun.
